mechanism: Both drugs are hepatotoxic and can cause elevated liver enzymes; pyrazinamide is particularly hepatotoxic and amoxicillin-clavulanate (especially clavulanate) can cause cholestatic hepatitis, increasing risk of additive hepatotoxicity.
action: Monitor liver function tests (AST, ALT, bilirubin) regularly during concurrent use; consider alternative antibiotics if possible, particularly in patients with baseline hepatic impairment.
